You must be shapeless, formless, like water. When you pour water in a cup, it becomes the cup. When you pour water into a bottle, it becomes the bottle. When you pour water into a teapot, it becomes the teapot. Water can drip and it can crash.

Jaw-dropping, in fact.

Only a really smart person would wear such a grea…

This belt has the second largest belt buckle you've ever seen in your life.

The problem is the buckle is on the back, but surprisingly this allows for you to have better balance in a fight.

That's great news because you just keep taking hits like they're nothing.

You don't have to be a genius to understand the utility of such a belt.

Go hit things.

items.Description: The weights on the end of this light, flexible chain make it an ideal weapon for catch swords or tangling other armed opponents.

items.Name: KwanDao
items.Description: The KwanDao, or long-handled sword, is an intimidating weapon. In ancient times it was the weapon of choice for generals. Because of this association and its magnificence, it was called the general of the hundred weapons.

items.Name: Lantern
items.Description: A lantern is an enclosed flame - making it more resistant to windy conditions than a torch or candle.

items.Name: Svirfneblin Pick
items.Description: Some picks, like this one, come from the deepest bowels of the earth where the deep gnomes dwell. They confer upon the user the ability to see in the dark and a resistance to spells found naturally in their maker's warrens.

items.Name: Eldritch Knight Large Shield
items.Description: Thrumming with power, this shield appears to be made of nothing but arcane magic. Unlike other shields, this arcane force does not disrupt magic as much as wood and steel.

items.Name: Lute
items.Description: The lute is the traditional stringed instrument of a bard.

items.Name: Monk's Habit
items.Description: A simple outfit, of the type a monk at a monastery might wear.

items.Name: Nagamaki
items.Description: This long-handled sword essentially consists of a katana blade mounted on a short pole.

items.Name: Naginata
items.Description: The Naginata is a Japanese polearm, in use at least from the 7th century onward. This weapon first saw use against mounted opponents where its long reach and sharp blade proved overwhelmingly effective. It is often wielded by monks and warrior priests. items.Name: Night's Final Rest
items.Description: Dark times call for strong measures and the creator of this ring knew the old adage as well as many. There are a few examples of this type of item still to be found in the realms, said to be proof against the enroachments of the undead.
PropertiesDecoded: Undead AC Bonus vs. Racial Group +2

items.Name: Heartstone
items.Description: All night hags carry this periapt, also called Charm of Blackness, which instantly cures any disease contracted by the holder. PropertiesDecoded: Immunity: Specific Spell Charm Person or Animal

items.Name: Ninja-to
items.Description: This is said to be the standard sword of a ninja, although undoubtedly these assassin's used many types of swords in their line of work. This particular sword is approximately two thirds the length of a katana, making it easy to conceal on the body.

items.Name: Nodachi
items.Description: Odachi literally translates as big thick sword. Often mistaken for Nodachi which translates as field sword. These are two-handed swords, used in place of the traditional katana and wakizashi of some warriors, but forged in a similar style.

items.Name: Papoose
items.Description: Fashion accessories make great weapons-of-convenience. Babies don't though.

items.Name: Pipes
items.Description: Pan pipes are an early wind instrument.

items.Name: Planetar Falchion
items.Description: Planetars wield powerful weapons of otherworldly enchantment.

items.Name: Planetar Longsword
items.Description: Planetars wield powerful weapons of otherworldly enchantment.

items.Name: Plane-Touched Noble's Garb
items.Description: Clothing of this sort is made for assorted partially or fully fiendish plane-touched. As their anatomy is often more than slightly out of the norm, they tend to require special consideration in their wardrobe....

items.Name: Poison Tipped Spear
items.Description: A sticky, tarry substance coats the tip of this spear. The poison is said to come from the prickly spines of a sea urchin found in southern waters.

items.Name: PuDao
items.Description: One of the long-handled sabers, the Pu Dao (Dashing Saber) has a short rod and longer saber blade. Commonly, the Pu Dao was used for ground-vs.-horseback attacks, but can also be an effective ground-to-ground weapon.

items.Name: Spider Rider Arrow
items.Description: A sticky yellow substance coats the head of the missile. It is said missiles such as these sap the strength from the muscles of those struck by it.

items.Name: Shadowed Hood
items.Description: This dark hood is highly obscuring, cloaking the wearer's face in shadow.

items.Name: Slave's Garb
items.Description: Sad indeed is the lot of those who find themselves thus garbed, for often their future is naught more than endless hours of back-breaking labor under the tender ministrations of the lash..

items.Name: Force Shield
items.Description: Thrumming with power, this shield appears to be made of nothing but arcane magic. Due to its small size and unique nature, this shield won't disrupt arcane casting.
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 10% of Weight

items.Name: Sun Shield
items.Description: Lighting the way with powerful protection against undead, this shield will not interfere with arcane casting.
PropertiesDecoded: Undead AC Bonus vs. Racial Group +2

items.Name: Studded Leather Armor
items.Description: Made of soft leather with steel rivets embedded in the surface, this armor offers more protection than a leather breastplate, but far more mobility than heavier armors. Armor of this type is popular amongst archers, rangers, and others who value mobility as much as protection.

items.Name: Tambourine
items.Description: This is a fancy, feathered tambourine.

items.Name: Tanto
items.Description: The tanto is a japanese dagger, similar in style to its better known cousins the katana and wakizashi.

items.Name: Tetsubo
items.Description: The Tetsubo is a long wooden rod, wielded with two hands, the upper half of which is covered with studded iron strips. Priests and wanderers often use it, since it can also serve as a walking stick.

items.Name: Thayvian Circlet
items.Description: Thayvian Circlets were created by the Red Wizards to help them fend off the aggressive Luskan Brotherhood. Though designed only to augment spellcasting abilities, they have the additional benefit of improving the wearer's hardiness, reflexes, and willpower. Since their introduct…

items.Name: Tiefling Chain Mail
items.Description: An imposing suit of armor, with special accommodations made for its owner's unique anatomy.

items.Name: Tonfa
items.Description: A short length of wood with a handle attached to the side, the tonfa is typically wielded in pairs and is used both defensively and offensively.

items.Name: Tiger Fork
items.Description: Renwald the Grey, a bard of some repute in the Northern Reaches, was known as much for his forked tongue as he was for his ability to escape the long arm of kings and wizards who bore the brunt of his barbs.

items.Name: Sahuagin Trident
items.Description: Cruel Sahuagin tridents are tipped with poison, making even a glancing blow deadly. A simple dweomer protects the haft and poison from dissolving in the water's depths.

items.Name: Joker's Barbs
items.Description: Renwald the Grey, a bard of some repute in the Northern Reaches, was known as much for his forked tongue as he was for his ability to escape the long arm of kings and wizards who bore the brunt of his barbs.

items.Name: Wall of Force
items.Description: This magical tower shield seems to absorb spells as if it feeds on them. Light as a feather though it grants the protection of 20lbs of steel.
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 10% of Weight

items.Name: Unholy Strength Sapping Longsword +2
items.Description: Some say that these swords, forged in blood and pain and misery, are the physical manifestation of minor demons on this plane of existence. Of course, some say that about tax collectors, too. That doesn't make it true.
PropertiesDecoded: Good Damage Bonus vs. Alignment Group 1d4 Damage

items.Name: Violin Bow
items.Description: Strung with horse hair, the bow is essential to bringing the tones of a violin to life.

items.Name: Violin
items.Description: This violin is a wonderful, delicate instrument.

items.Name: Wakizashi
items.Description: The wakizashi is the shorter of the two swords in a daisho (the other being the katana). Some master swordsmen are said to be able to wield the two at the same time, creating a whirlwind of steel and death.

items.Name: Warrior Monk's Outfit
items.Description: This set of garments is clearly designed with movement in mind, as it is made to restrict the wearer's motions as little as possible.

items.Name: Winged Helm
items.Description: A fancy-looking helm, befitting a ranking warrior or nobleman.

items.Name: Wizard's Robes
items.Description: Officious and impressive robes, sure to help a magus of any stripe claim the respect they deserve.

items.Name: Sunder Dark
items.Description: These capriciously named weapons are blessed by Eilistraee. Though few outside her faithful are likely to have trust in her good graces, these weapons have always proved their worth on the field of battle.

items.Name: Heavy Mace of Disruption +3
items.Description: This, the chosen weapon of Astral Devas, can be used to great effect, particularly against the undead.
PropertiesDecoded: Slay Racial Group On Hit DC=14

items.Name: Mage's Heavy Mace
items.Description: Weapons of this sort serve mainly as fashion accessories for vain and presumptuous spellcasters, but nonetheless have saved the skin of many a mage in times of trouble.

items.Name: Blade Dervish
items.Description: Tierney Fsstaff was a traveler who prided herself on her feet never retracing her steps, as she strove to find new vistas over every next horizon. It was on these travels, and because of them, that she became quite capable of defending herself and her traveling companions. The o…

items.Name: Blades of Grass
items.Description: The legend goes that weapons such as these were crafted from the emerald greenery of Silvanus' own grove, that those that seek to keep the wild places safe might do so convincingly. Some doubt that this is factual, but the honed edges of the swords do grow sharper and greener if…

items.Description: A small Netherese bauble somehow found its way into the pocket of a halfling named Torias, who, thinking it might make a stylish addition to his dagger's hilt, left it and his tiny blade in the care of a Bedine smith. items.Name: Bright Sands Falchion
items.Description: Blades of this type were blessed by wandering clerics of The Morning Lord in an effort to spread the faith to the peoples of the vast eastern desert.
PropertiesDecoded: Undead Damage Bonus vs. Racial Type 1d6 Damage

items.Name: Serpent's Tongue Falchion
items.Description: This falchion has been enchanted to both sear and slash adversaries with its poison-laced edge. It bears no maker's mark.

items.Name: Yari
items.Description: The yari is a japanese spear (or lance), used for stabbing. It is not weighted properly for throwing.

items.Name: Zebra Hide
items.Description: This is the pelt of a zebra, a creature rumoured to be found in some far reaches of the world.
